text.p: - These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Syria to attend Baghdad's international trade fair that will be held in November.
- President Saddam Hussein says that despite Iraq's limited possession of technology and knowhow it was able to prevent the U.S.-led coalition in 1991 from achieving its vicious goals against Iraq.
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and QADISSIYA)
- A United Nations mission says Iraq's oil-for-food deal with the U.N. is not enough to meet the needs of Iraqis.
- An Iraqi oil source says that imposing taxes on oil sales by Western countries is a political game.
